cssDesign.objective: Provide guidelines and best practices for creating consistent, maintainable CSS designs using Tailwind CSS with a flex-first approach and utility functions for class organization.

flexFirstApproach.description: Use flex layouts as the primary layout method for consistent, responsive designs.

header.code: <header className={cn("flex items-center justify-between", "h-[90px] flex-shrink-0 px-6 relative z-10")}>

mainContent.code: <main className={cn("flex flex-1 justify-center items-center", "relative z-10 p-6 md:p-12")}>

componentStructure.description: Organize UI components with a clear nesting structure.
recommendations: Use semantic HTML elements whenever possible.
Avoid unnecessary nesting of div elements.

utilityFunction.description: Always import and use the `cn()` utility function from `@/lib/utils.ts`.

classGrouping.description: Group related Tailwind classes with the `cn()` utility and use comments to identify each group.
classGrouping.example: <button className={cn("flex justify-center items-center relative", "w-full py-3 rounded-lg", "bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/90", "text-primary-foreground font-medium", "shadow-lg shadow-primary/20", "hover:from-primary/90 hover:to-primary/80", "disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed", "transition-all", className)} {...props} />

stateBasedClasses.description: Group state-based classes separately for better readability.

dynamicClassApplication.description: Use conditional classes with the `cn()` function and ternary operators.
dynamicClassApplication.example: <div className={cn("flex flex-col w-full max-w-md relative", "transform transition-all duration-700", isVisible ? "translate-y-0 opacity-100" : "translate-y-8 opacity-0")}>

glassMorphism.description: Create glass morphism effects using opacity, blur, and backdrop-filter.
glassMorphism.example: <div className={cn("p-8 rounded-xl relative overflow-hidden", "bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md", "border border-border/50", "shadow-[0_10px_40px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]")}>

gradients.description: Use subtle gradients for backgrounds and buttons.

animationEffects.description: Create overlay effects with absolute positioning.

mobileFirstApproach.description: Design for mobile first, then add responsive variants.
mobileFirstApproach.example: <div className={cn("p-4 flex flex-col gap-2", "md:p-6 md:flex-row md:gap-4", "lg:p-8 lg:gap-6")}>

scrollHandling.description: Control overflow and scrolling behavior appropriately.
examples: <div className={cn("flex text-red-500 text-sm mt-1", "max-h-[6em] overflow-y-auto", "bg-red-50/10 rounded p-2", "border border-red-200/20")}>

accessibility.description: Include appropriate ARIA attributes for decorative elements.

performance.description: Group related styles in the `cn()` function to reduce class string length.
recommendations: Prefer Tailwind's built-in animations and transitions over custom CSS.

maintainability.description: Create reusable UI components with consistent styling patterns.
recommendations: Document complex visual effects with comments.
Prefer Tailwind's utility classes over custom CSS when possible.
Use descriptive variable names for state that affects styling.
